messages:
Aisha K: Hey team — need a quick coverage swap. Flight canceled last minute, I can't do my 07:00->15:00 oncall. I can shadow until 08:30 though. There's an active P1 for the embeddings-queue (lowish traffic but pagers are live). @oncall-bot can you confirm current pager state?

incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: P1 - embeddings-queue-backlog (investigating). Pager escalation active. Triggered at 2026-03-14T05:12:08Z.

Jon R: I can take primary until 12:00 if someone else can cover 12:00-15:00. I will need temporary creds to the staging DB to run verification scripts. @ops-bot can you provision read-only for 4h?

ops-bot: Temporary access request logged: ticket #OPS-5129. Auto-approved for oncall rotation. Credentials will be provisioned via vault at `secret/oncall/temp/1799998888`.

Marcel: I can pick up 12:00-15:00. @Aisha K please DM any handoff notes. Also, is this P1 customer-impacting or internal-only?

Aisha K: It's impacting a small subset of enterprise customers (~7% of incoming batches failing ingestion). We have retries in place but latency/backpressure is visible. No sales escalation yet but SRE is monitoring.

Priya S: Runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue. Key commands: 
```bash
# check queue length
kubectl -n inference exec pod/queue-worker -- /app/bin/queue-stats
# trigger manual retry
python /opt/tools/retry_batches.py --limit 100
```

Taylor M: If Jon needs DB read-only: `psql -h embeddings-db.prod -U readonly -c "select count(*) from batches where status='failed'"`

Jon R: OK I'll take primary. I'll post a short handover when Aisha finishes.

Aisha K: Handing off now — I'll be available on GChat until 08:30. Known quirks: job scheduler can OOM on bursts (see runbook section 'oom-hint'). If you see `OOMKilled` on queue-worker, restart with `kubectl rollout restart deployment/queue-worker` and then `kubectl -n inference logs -f deployment/queue-worker`.

Marcel: Noted. I'll assume primary at 12:00 and escalate to infra if retries don't clear backlog within 30m. If it gets hairy, open an incident bridge and ping @eng-sre.

incident-bot: Update: Pager suppressed for low-severity retries. Current backlog: 4,600 batches. Estimated catch-up at current consumption: ~45m.

Jon R: :thumbsup: Starting now. I'll monitor dashboards (metrics: metrics.redwood/embeds-queue, logs: logs.redwood/streams/queue).

Priya S: Also, if you need to force to fallback queue, POST payload below to `/ops/reroute` (auth: oncall-token): 
```json
{"action": "reroute", "target": "fallback-queue"}
```

Taylor M: I'll be on secondary standby 08:00-12:00. Ping me if primary needs help and I'll jump in.

Aisha K: Confirmed swap: @Jon R primary 07:00-12:00, @Marcel primary 12:00-15:00, @Taylor M secondary 08:00-12:00. I'll DM the customer-impact snippet for PSRs and update PagerDuty.

ops-bot: PagerDuty note updated: 'Primary swap: Jon R -> Marcel at 12:00. Shadowing: Aisha K until 08:30. Secondary: Taylor M 08:00-12:00.'

Jon R: Handover summary (posting to thread):
- Took primary at 07:05
- Backlog 4.6k -> 3.9k over 20m
- No new error spike in last 5m
- Actions: manual retry 100 batches, scaled queue-worker +1 replica
- Next check: 08:00

Marcel: I'll assume the primary role at 12:00. Can someone drop a calendar invite for visibility?

Aisha K: Invite sent to oncall calendar titled 'primary swap: Jon->Marcel 12:00-15:00'.

incident-bot: Incident update: backlog decreasing, customer-impact flag remains 'limited'. No escalation required at this time.

Taylor M: :white_check_mark: acknowledged, watching from 08:00.

Aisha K: Thanks everyone — leaving this thread open for live notes. I'll follow up with a short postmortem checklist if anything changes.
